# [Audit]: Short descriptive title of the issue

## Before
What is currently broken, sub-optimal, missing, or in need of refactoring? Include exact file paths and line numbers if known.

## Evidence
Add code snippets, reproduction steps, or context found during research/audit.

## Proposed
Describe the recommended solution or refactoring approach.

## After
What will the codebase or user experience look like after this change is implemented?
